scope: Same-author verification of a conditional imposed-source transport calculation, not independent review or an observational likelihood.

checks.name: Collisionless quadrature agrees with independent radiation-era closed form
Comoving-momentum receiver preserves extremely cold momentum without subtracting rest energy
All production runs conserve number, charge and energy including core exchange and expansion
Receiver horizon is stable across all three grid/time/source-bin refinements
Every production run uses the same pinned ground-object rate table
Independent first-event optical-depth quadrature converges from order 32 to 64
Conversion energy and charge use the chemical potential, with consistent daughter mass accounting
Rejected active-grid path estimator is fenced from physical conclusions

rejected_diagnostic.control: Zero reactions must reproduce the independent collisionless horizon for both initial particles.
rejected_diagnostic.consequence: Do not use active-grid path moments as a certified free-streaming result. Released conclusions use the separate comoving-momentum receiver, analytic quadrature and the causal prefix bound.

open_gates: Actual formation spectrum and cosmological production history
Evolving object profiles and additional interactions
Elastic-angle transport and a mixed-species perturbation calculation
